nsmbds-v0.4.6-alpha.description:
This update adds Star Coin Sign logic, expands the progressive keys, and improves Universal Tracker compatibility. Blocksanity detection has also been reworked to use the native block-hit function, improving both reliability and performance.
### Added

* Added Star Coin Sign logic with three modes:
  * Progressive
  * Individual
  * Vanilla
* Added three new progressive key items:
  * World 6 Tower 2 Key
  * World 8 Tower 2 Key
  * World 8 Bowser's Castle Key
* Added location groups for:
  * Star Coins
  * Secret Exits
  * Red Coin Challenges
  * 1-Up Blocks
  * Blocksanity
  * Toad Houses
### Changed

* Reworked the logic to use Archipelago's Rule Builder for better Universal Tracker compatibility and explanations
* ~~Changed Blocksanity hit detection to use the game's native block-hit function~~
* Improved a bit the Lua runtime performance
### Fixed

* Fixed Linux path compatibility when selecting and launching BizHawk
* Fixed disabled filler items still being distributed by the generator
* Fixed World 7-3 Star Coin 3 requiring the wrong Power-Up and added the Large Mario requirement
* Fixed tracking for Flying Block 2 in World 7-Ghost House Blocksanity

### Important

A new seed is required to use the new Star Coin Sign logic and progressive key items. Generating a new seed is also required for the filler item distribution fix to take effect.

For a explanations of the randomizer and its features or installation and setup:
* **[Game Info](https://github.com/Lemix028/Archipelago-NewSuperMarioBrosDS/tree/nsmbds/worlds/nsmbds/docs/en_New%20Super%20Mario%20Bros.%20DS.md)**
* **[Setup Guide](https://github.com/Lemix028/Archipelago-NewSuperMarioBrosDS/tree/nsmbds/worlds/nsmbds/docs/setup_en.md)**
